name: Deblock Visa debit card (Standard / Premium / Native)

issuer.name: Deblock SAS (Lille, RCS 852 173 210) — electronic money institution authorised by the ACPR (CIB 17748) and crypto-asset service provider (CASP) registered with the AMF (A2025-001); T&C §3.2: 'Deblock délivrera au Client une carte de débit Deblock unique'; cards page: 'Deblock is a direct VISA member'. No partner bank or BIN sponsor is named.

funding.supported_assets_note: The card debits the euro current account (EMI account with IBAN). Crypto is held in a separate non-custodial wallet inside the app and must be sold into euros first (buy/sell/swap fee 1.99% Standard, 0.49% Premium, free Native); help article: card payments cannot be made directly with cryptocurrencies (article listed, not read). Top-ups by card, PayPal (eligible countries), SEPA and instant transfers; a percentage of salary can be converted to crypto for free.

eligibility.nationality_restrictions_note: T&C v12.2 §3.4.1 / §3.5: the client declares being over 18 and having 'la résidence permanente en France'; must 'résider légalement en France' to open an account; one personal account per person; US persons excluded. Help centre: 'You must be 18 or older to open a Deblock account.'
eligibility.usage_note: Only the French-language T&C (v12.2, 1 Dec 2025) were read; they require French residence. Deblock also publishes referral terms in Italian and a PayPal top-up line 'in eligible countries', so other EU markets may have their own terms — not read this run (to_confirm). Cards 'work globally in the Visa network' (help article 2025-02-12); the help centre has a dedicated 'French Pacific Territories' collection (not read).

kyc.thresholds_note: No verification tier or threshold: services are available only after the 'statut d'identité vérifiée' is granted (T&C §3.5.2). Card payment cap: 'each card payment you make is capped at €10,000' (help article 2025-02-13).
kyc.stages_note: Account opening = full verification: phone number and email, a colour video of an official identity document issued by an EU state, Monaco, Andorra or Switzerland (with MRZ), a selfie video and a qualified electronic signature (T&C §3.5.1–3.5.2); help centre: 'You can verify your identity during your sign-up process in the Deblock app' and 'you will be asked to provide your proof of identity and a photograph'. Cards are ordered from the verified account.

access.note: Fee schedule: Standard plan 'Free'; cards page: Standard card 'Free forever'.

fees.conditions: Physical card free within the limit of one per year ('delivery fees may apply'); 1 virtual card and 3 single-use cards included (fee schedule EN 2025-05-28 / FR 2026-11-07). Pricing page says '5 per day' one-off cards for Standard (differs from the schedule's three).
Fee schedule: 'delivery fees may apply' (no amount); pricing page: 0 free express deliveries on Standard. Standard delivery cost not published on the pages read.
Standard plan: Free (fee schedule and pricing page).

Card top-up: free up to 2,000 EUR per 30-day billing cycle, then 0.5% (all plans; FR schedule from 2026-11-07, EN schedule 2025-05-28 'per calendar month'). PayPal top-up: same, in eligible countries. Separate 'AFT' line (Standard): free for one transaction or 500 EUR per cycle, then 1 EUR + 2%. SEPA and instant transfers in: free.
Crypto buy, sell and swap: 1.99% on Standard (fee schedule and pricing page). Converting a percentage of salary to crypto: free.

Governing value = dated fee schedule applicable from 7 Nov 2026 (FR v6.4.2), non-EUR card payments 'sous conditions': 0.5% on weekdays (Mon–Fri, Paris time), 1% on weekends; once card spending in a cycle exceeds 1,000 EUR, 1% on all further card payments until the end of the cycle; +0.5% on some merchant categories (financial services, money transfers, prepaid loads, crypto, quasi-cash, gambling, precious metals/jewellery) in any currency. Help article 'Are there any fees for making card payments?' (2026-05-05): 'Everyone gets €500/month with zero FX markup', then Standard '0.5% on weekdays, 1% on weekends'. Cards page: 'Deblock doesn't charge any FX fee on card payments abroad'. Modelled at the weekday schedule rate; weekend/over-threshold rate is 1%.

Standard: free for one withdrawal or 100 EUR per 30-day cycle (whichever comes first), then 1% (min 1 EUR) — euro-zone ATMs of other banks; cards page: 0% FX on ATM abroad with a 'plan-dependent' limit. Pricing page: ATM limit 15,000 EUR.

Calculated on the settled amount after fees. Payout asset not stated ('cashback balance' in the app). editorial.summary: Visa debit card of Deblock SAS, a French electronic money institution (ACPR) and registered crypto-asset service provider (AMF) that issues the card itself as a direct Visa member. The euro account and the non-custodial crypto wallet sit side by side in one app; the card spends euros, so crypto must be sold first (1.99% on the free Standard plan, 0.49% on Premium, free on the NFT-gated Native plan). Standard is free with one physical card a year, one virtual card and one free ATM withdrawal or 100 EUR per 30-day cycle; Premium costs 14.99 EUR a month or 120 EUR a year per the dated fee schedule (the pricing page still shows 10 EUR) and adds 0.1% to 1% cashback depending on the merchant's country, three free withdrawals or 1,000 EUR, insurance and metal cards. Non-EUR card payments are the main open point: the fee schedule in force since 7 November 2026 lists 0.5% on weekdays and 1% at weekends for all plans, while the help centre grants everyone 500 EUR a month at zero markup and Premium 0% always, and the cards page advertises no FX fee at all. Opening an account requires French residence under the French terms and full identity verification.
good_for: French residents who want a regulated euro account, Visa debit card and crypto wallet in one app from a French EMI/CASP
Premium or Native users spending mostly outside the EEA, where cashback reaches 1% with no cap
NFT holders on the Native plan: free plan, free crypto trading and Premium-level allowances
not_for: Residents outside France until the terms for other markets are read (the French T&C require French residence; US persons are excluded)
Spending crypto directly: the card debits the euro account only, after a 1.99% / 0.49% sale on Standard / Premium
Cashback seekers on the free plan: Standard earns 0%; inside the EEA even Premium earns only 0.1%
Anyone who needs a clear FX fee today: three official pages give three different answers
watch_outs: Premium price: 14.99 EUR/month or 120 EUR/year in the fee schedule in force since 7 Nov 2026 vs '10€/mo' on the pricing page.

Non-EUR card payments: fee schedule 0.5% weekdays / 1% weekends (1% once card spend passes 1,000 EUR in a cycle; +0.5% on some merchant categories) for all plans; help article (May 2026): 500 EUR/month free for everyone, then Standard 0.5%/1% and Premium 0%; cards page: 0%. The schedule's conditions text was partly garbled in the fetch — browser re-read needed.
Cashback is paid only on Premium and Native and only 0.1% at EEA / French-territory merchants; payout asset not stated.
Top-ups by card are free only up to 2,000 EUR per cycle (then 0.5%); a separate 'AFT' fee line (1 EUR + 2% / 1%) applies beyond small allowances.
Each card payment is capped at 10,000 EUR (help centre) although the cards page says 'No spending cap'.
Native plan requires holding a Deblock NFT for 30 days; the plan is not shown on the pricing page.
Only the French T&C (v12.2) were read; eligibility in other EU countries is to be confirmed.
